title: Die Hard Trilogy (Japan v1.000): cartridge-address waits
summary: Preserve the inherited forced-ready workaround in all six disc executables.
rationale: Preserve all eighteen literal-backed waits across six exact-source executables, retaining AND/TST/BT CPU outcomes while removing cartridge reads. Reuse the public twelve-record engine and standalone CRC. See doc/OCTOBER-REVISION-PROFILES.md for source/caller/timing/audio limits. Keep opt-in with the original callback available.

writes.reason: Replace the erroneous MOV.W @R1,R0; retain the following AND #4,R0, TST R0,R0 and BT. The inherited FF byte forces the same successful condition.
